channel.title: DevCentr News
channel.description: News and engineering blog posts from Dev-Centr.

item.title: Intents, not shell translation
item.description: One playbook should name what you want. PlayTime binds how on this computer. Equivalence Engine is a catalog -- not a blender that turns bash into PowerShell.

item.title: When a Cloud project pretends to be an app
item.description: Google Cloud forces personal OAuth into Project-shaped boxes—consent, quotas, and API enablement included. Here is the mental model we document instead.

item.title: When API keys wear token costumes
item.description: Vendors keep labeling long-lived dashboard secrets as tokens. Here is the architectural split Dev-Centr is forcing into docs and Secrets Manager—and why the wrong word keeps breaking security reviews.

item.title: Business Bootstrap becomes a support-systems hub
item.description: Founder ops docs grow past email—scheduling, design, and vaults get their own capability areas on docs.devcentr.org.

item.title: MSI tables land in the generator
item.description: msi-generator v0.2 writes real OLE2 compound files, cabinets, and core Windows Installer tables — still unsigned, no longer an empty stub.

item.title: Easy Installer becomes Ibex
item.description: Install Builder EXtension — new name, logo, and OS package registries for the installer-authoring CLI.

item.title: Easy Installer ships
item.description: A CLI and Explorer menu for installer projects and Install in-place PATH — without waiting on a full MSI every time you want a tool on PATH.

item.title: Easy Installer emits CI pipelines
item.description: Scaffold GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, CircleCI, or Bitbucket workflows for installer builds — without packaging on your laptop.

item.title: We’re partnering with OpenShellOrg (on purpose)
item.description: DevCentr and OpenShellOrg are locking in the sibling story—toolchain ownership on our side, shell entrypoint honesty on theirs.

item.title: We’re opening a News desk
item.description: Why DevCentr is starting a public News feed—and what you won't find here.

item.title: Stop dumping people into the docs
item.description: We built a Help hub so “I need assistance” doesn't mean “go read the manual.”

item.title: Our logo shouldn’t need a proprietary player
item.description: Why DevCentr's new mark stays in SVG—and why we're cautious about Rive as a default for open brands.
